Build prompt

Rebuild this interaction 1:1: Monopoly Go's menu tooltip - the hamburger menu sheet slides in over the board, the TYCOON CLUB row highlights, and a bottom tooltip with the Mr. Monopoly mascot slides up and bounces into place to point it out.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
The game board behind; a right-anchored menu sheet with the player profile header ("tishi", avatar), menu rows (SHOP, TYCOON CLUB, NET WORTH, MY SHOWROOM, DAILY TREATS, MAP, BOARD REPORT, SETTINGS) and a CONNECT button at the bottom. The tooltip is a white bubble with a small Mr. Monopoly mascot on its left and copy: "Remember: you can access the Tycoon Club portal from the menu at any time!"

## Motion spec
Pattern: sheet entrance + spotlight row + bouncing tooltip.
- The menu sheet slides in from the right edge (translateX 100% -> 0, 300ms, ease-out) over a 40% black dim.
- 150ms after the sheet lands, the TYCOON CLUB row highlights (white pill background expands around it, 200ms, ease-out) while the other rows dim slightly.
- The tooltip slides up from the bottom edge (translateY 120% -> 0, spring ~300/16, ~500ms) with a visible overshoot bounce and a small rotation wobble (-2deg -> 0) as it lands.
- The mascot on the tooltip pops a beat later (scale 0.6 -> 1, spring ~400/15, 250ms) - the tooltip leads, the mascot follows.
- The tooltip holds with a gentle bob (translateY +/-3px, 2s loop) until dismissed.

## Calibration
- The bounce is one overshoot and settle - playful, not jiggly.
- Row highlight and tooltip entrance overlap by ~100ms so the eye travels from the row down to the tooltip.

## Reduced motion
Sheet slides, tooltip fades in place; no bounce or bob.

## Don't miss
- The tooltip anchors to the bottom of the screen, not to the menu row - it points up at the sheet.
- The dim applies only to the board, not to the menu sheet.
